title: The combination: decision models inside the workflow model's loop, and the third arm
request: Phase 4: combine DCLab's decision models with the workflow model so the workflow model decides more, faster, each decision checked.
spec: decide.ask answers the workflow points too and reads a journey arm's routing; the Home agent's decide_point tool; the prompt sentence; journeys --live-arms (the rules, the workflow model alone, the two together), capped.
plan: Offer the decision models to the Home agent as a read tool built from the draft's own state.
Keep every validator: a routed model may add a caution, never remove one.
Measure the third arm live on the dev journeys under a cap.

decisions.decision: decide_point builds the state itself from the draft.
decisions.why: A model filling a state of bands from text would invent bands.

decisions.decision: A live arm cut short by its budget is not stored.
decisions.why: A model arm whose last journeys fell back to the rules would measure the rules.

change: decide (WORKFLOW points, rule_value, scope routing, CAUTIONS), chat.decide_point and _problem_state, use.scoped, the prompt, journeys __main__ _live_arms and store_compare's routing and spend.

findings.defect: decide_point reported disagreements that were not.
findings.scenario: The rules' raw field (target_check) was compared with models trained on target.
findings.cause: The rule's answer was not read as the ledger records it.
findings.fix: The rule's answer goes through SAME and none while a question waits.

findings.defect: A routed model's answer was acted on without the point's validator.
findings.scenario: A model routed at level 3 answering no for order_id would free an identifier.
findings.fix: A model may never free a column the rules hold back.

findings.defect: An exhausted live arm silently became the rules, and broken journeys' cost was not counted.
findings.scenario: The Home client falls back to its script when its budget runs out.
findings.cause: The loop did not watch the budget; spend was summed from rows.
findings.fix: The arm stops before a journey could run out and is then not stored; spend is read from the clients.

outcome: The workflow model can ask the decision models at every typed decision, through the validator; the live measurement of the three arms follows.
lessons: A tool a model calls must apply the same validator as the code path it replaces.
risks: The twin runs' third lane is not built.
